questions.text: Is the business holding money or property that belongs to someone else and has gone unclaimed (uncashed cheques, customer credits, unpaid wages, dormant deposits)?
questions.help: Every state requires a business that holds such property to report it, and then hand it over, after a set time with no contact from the owner. Tick this if your books carry any.

questions.text: Does the business hold personal information about customers, employees or other people (names with account, card, licence or Social Security numbers)?
questions.help: State laws require a business to tell the people affected, and often the state attorney general, when such information is exposed in a security breach.
